native_mechanisms: Silence-swats: the whole ordered pile/heap is laid on the stone (absorbed) before any folding begins, so input order is fixed first.

Each heap races the musk deer's mountain stride — uphill twist (rotate), downhill fold (xor), doubling-back that eats its own trail (state <- f(state)) — until no heap keeps its entering shape; carried forward into the next heap, plus square-searching (90-degree turns folding corners into the centre) until one changed mark smears across every square.
The owl's seal: the final folded shape is fixed to one small invariant size, and intermediate heaps are burned so the token cannot be walked back to its marks (one-wayness).
core_technique: ChaCha-style ARX permutation (add-rotate-xor quarter-rounds, column then diagonal rounds) over a 16x64-bit state absorbing XOR-ed 128-byte blocks with a block counter, plus splitmix64 finalization and overlapping-tail/short-input regimes, AVX2-vectorized.
